page.overview:
Who is Anril?

Anril was a male Pureblood Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire living during the Galactic War. Following the death of Empress Vaylin and formation of the Eternal Alliance in 3630 BBY, Anril defected from the Empire and joined a rogue faction led by Major Korven. Operating from the Vanguard Station, they began targeting and destroying nearby Alliance outposts. This eventually prompted the Alliance to retaliate and in defending the Vanguard Station against the assault, both Anril and Korven were killed.

Lord Anril appears in Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne during the final boss fight of "Fractured" Uprising.
